text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 11: A known small signal is recovered in full'

g.text: Figure 11: A known small signal is recovered in full

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'The synthetic product is each hour's measured output plus random noise, sized so the synthetic gain would be about the size of the solar headline gain. The comparison recovers that known gain: 0.13 points for solar and 0.14 for wind. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months and a fitting seed. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, August 2024 to September 2026. Post hoc: chosen after the first run's results, and fixed before the re-run that produced the numbers on this page. Every other row is exploratory.'
